data.label: Receive CSV File
data.description: Trigger when a new incoming CSV file is received for validation.

data.label: Load Validation Schema
data.description: Retrieve the expected column list, data types, required fields, and numeric range rules.

data.label: Parse CSV Content
data.description: Read and structure the incoming CSV file into rows and columns for validation.

data.label: Check Expected Columns
data.description: Compare CSV headers against the expected schema and identify missing or unexpected columns.

data.label: Validate Data Types
data.description: Verify that each column value matches the data type defined in the schema.

data.label: Check Required Nulls
data.description: Flag null, empty, or missing values in fields marked as required.

data.label: Validate Numeric Ranges
data.description: Check numeric fields against acceptable minimum and maximum values from the schema.

data.label: Aggregate Validation Errors
data.description: Collect all validation failures from column, type, null, and range checks into a single error set.

data.label: Generate Validation Report
data.description: Create a validation report listing all discovered errors and the overall file status.

data.label: Publish Validation Result
data.description: Output the completed validation report for downstream review or processing.

data.condition: required columns present or column issues recorded
data.label: if columns acceptable

message: The workflow starts with CSV file intake, loads the expected schema, parses the file, and then performs sequential validation checks for columns, data types, required nulls, and numeric ranges. All validation issues are aggregated into a single result, which is then used to generate and publish a validation report.
